name: Irontree Clearing
summary: Irontree Clearing is a deforested expanse situated in northern Felwood beside the Irontree Woods. Dominated by aggressive goblin industrial ventures, the site features strip mining and clear-cutting operations run by noisy shredders amidst the blighted wilderness.

sections.title: Industrial Encroachment
sections.body: Carved straight out of the corrupt forests of northern Felwood, Irontree Clearing marks the industrial reach of goblin enterprise into sacred ancient groves. Centered around Irontree Cavern, the clearing is bustling with whirring Irontree Shredders tearing down corrupted timber and strip-mining the surrounding earth. Rather than showing deference to the wounded woodland, these opportunistic entrepreneurs strip every resource they can find, heedless of the lingering demonic taint soaking the soil.

sections.title: Escalating Hostilities
sections.body: The relentless clear-cutting and industrial noise have provoked fierce resistance from the night elf sentinels keeping watch nearby. Operating in close proximity to Talonbranch Glade, the encroaching loggers have clashed directly with native defenders trying to halt the destruction of their ancestral woodlands. With shredders churning through the trees and local tensions boiling over, the clearing has become an active front of resource-fueled skirmishing.

faq.answer: Irontree Clearing is a deforested section of northern Felwood containing strip mining operations, goblin logging machinery, and Irontree Cavern.
Goblins operate the heavy shredders and strip mining apparatus throughout the clearing, harvesting lumber and minerals regardless of the land's corruption.

faq.q: Why are the night elves upset about this camp?
faq.answer: The night elves from nearby settlements like Talonbranch Glade fiercely object to the blatant destruction and logging of their ancestral forest lands.
Irontree Cavern is a prominent cave structure sitting directly at the heart of the clearing, surrounded by the ongoing excavation and resource gathering.

angles.text: Watching heavy iron shredders tear through ancient trees is a grotesque sight to druids, whose foremost goal in Felwood is cleansing the rampant corruption rather than commercializing it.
The mechanical shredders operating in the clearing demonstrate goblin engineering's ruthless efficiency at mass deforestation and excavation in hostile environments.
